evidence_quotes.O: I overclocked this some more by using the EVGA Precision X that comes on the included CD. Overclocked it by another 77mhz core clock and 128 mhz memory clock
evidence_quotes.C: I just found out that it was my power supply which was making it do this. Switched it out for a Corsair CX600 600W PSU and now its outstanding.
evidence_quotes.E: I have never had a more powerful card in my life. This is an absolute beast of a card.
evidence_quotes.A: One trick to putting these screen protectors on is to turn on a shower in a closed bathroom. This will make all dust float to the ceiling
evidence_quotes.N: It was making a whining noise from the fans which was super annoying.
